name: "That land / that creature doesn't untap" takes its target's words — Stensia Innkeeper, Somnophore, Plant Tadpoles, Telekinesis
notes: Found while auditing the doesn't-untap rules (2026-11-20). "Tap target land an opponent controls. That land doesn't untap …" (Stensia Innkeeper): "that land" was read as a group (every land got the trait); the pronoun subjects of the rule block now include that land / artifact / enchantment and their plurals. "Tap target creature that player controls" (Somnophore): _pronounAntecedentInfo gave up on the word "player" and the picker offered every permanent; "that player controls" is now read like "an opponent controls" (the player dealt damage is not known, so any creature). "Tap X target creatures. They don't untap …" (Plant Tadpoles, X = 2): the antecedent dropped a bare count before "target", so a single picker; it now keeps "two / 2 / X-as-a-number target". Telekinesis keeps "next two untap steps" plural.
